bugs_fixed.bug: False positive on provider name lookup (Ms. Opeyemi Kemiki Dada triggered emergency)
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Haiku classifier unreliable on provider names. No safe-prefix bypass for info requests.
bugs_fixed.fix: Added safe-prefix bypass for 'tell me about', 'find me', etc. Hardened AI prompt with explicit 'NEVER EMERGENCY' rules for provider/info queries. Changed default-on-AI-failure from escalate to keyword-only fallback.

bugs_fixed.bug: Unlock code visible in safety audit record
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Chat history stored raw without de-identification. Admin unlock key ('unlock$123') captured in transcript.
bugs_fixed.fix: Added deIdentify() call on chat history before storing in safety audit trail.

bugs_fixed.bug: Triggering message missing from audit history
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Backend received history WITHOUT current message (frontend sends them separately). _lock_ip_db only got prior history.
bugs_fixed.fix: Append body.message to history before passing to _lock_ip_db: full_history = list(history) + [{'role': 'user', 'content': body.message}]

enhancements_implemented.enhancement: Full conversation history in safety audit
enhancements_implemented.description: Safety audit now captures the complete de-identified conversation up to the trigger point, not just the last message. Enables incident review with full context.

enhancements_implemented.enhancement: Switched safety classifier from Claude Haiku to GPT-4.1-mini
enhancements_implemented.description: Better classification accuracy on edge cases. Vendor diversity (OpenAI for safety, Anthropic for chat). 2.5x cheaper than Haiku at scale ($83K/year vs $438K/year per 1M users).

test_results.manual_uat: Emergency trigger, IP lock, admin unlock, audit record with full de-identified history - all verified by Boss
